mechanism: Both agents have sympathomimetic properties; brimonidine is an alpha-2 agonist and methylphenidate is a sympathomimetic stimulant, potentially leading to additive cardiovascular and CNS effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and CNS symptoms; consider alternative ADHD medication if patient develops hypertension or tachycardia; brimonidine ophthalmic has minimal systemic absorption but interaction risk increases with higher doses or prolonged use.
